summary: API test INTERNAL_RELOCATION (Internal relocation between racks) — CURRENT_MOVEMENT domain

inputMeaning.ADMIN_INPUT: minBatteryPercent=25 — set by the admin when the template is created; stored in variablesSchema.configuredValue; the runtime only reads it.
inputMeaning.STAFF_INPUT: Not used for movement fields. Request-level STAFF_INPUT (if any) appears in request-input-schema.workflowInputs.
inputMeaning.SYSTEM_VALUE: assignedRobotId, transportRequestId, jobId — resolved at runtime by SystemVariableResolver; never entered by hand.
inputMeaning.CURRENT_MOVEMENT: containerId, source.endpointId, destination.endpointId — source of truth is TransportRequestDetail / JobTask.ContextValues; not duplicated in VariablesSchema.
inputMeaning.bindings: Every step input binds from WORKFLOW_VAR / CONSTANT / CURRENT_MOVEMENT / STEP_OUTPUT — nothing is hard-coded in the executor.

processing.draftCreate: ValidateDraft (structural): unique keys, required fields. Status=DRAFT. Persisted: workflows + workflow_tasks + workflow_steps; variablesSchema JSONB; input_bindings JSONB; config JSONB (operationCode).
processing.publish: ValidateForPublish (full registry): every required input needs a binding of the right type; SYSTEM_VALUE keys must be in the catalog; CURRENT_MOVEMENT paths must be valid; CONSTANT values must be in allowedValues. Status=PUBLISHED + publishedAt.
processing.runtimeNotYetWired: Job Runtime Provisioning (ExecutionSnapshot → Job/JobContainer/JobTask/JobStep via IJobRuntimeProvisioner) is implemented as a service. Job Planner, TransportRequest API, dispatch/assignment, and runtime orchestrator (VariableContextBuilder → StepInputResolver → executor) are NOT implemented yet. Template does not store runtime results.

storageShape.table_workflows: code, version_no, name, status, variables_schema (jsonb), created_by, created_at, published_at
storageShape.table_workflow_steps: workflow_task_id, step_key, name, step_type, sequence_no, config (jsonb: operationCode), input_bindings (jsonb), timeout/maxAttempts/onFailure

exampleResolvedInputsAtRuntime.note: Illustration only — the Job API is not called. Movement values come from JobTask.ContextValues (CURRENT_MOVEMENT), not from WorkflowInputs.
